Primary key 'patient_id' in dim_patients must be strictly unique.
Primary key 'encounter_id' in fact_encounters must be strictly unique.
Primary key 'provider_id' in dim_providers must be strictly unique.

Flags multiple claims with identical patient, provider, service date, and amount.
Gender must be standard category 'M' or 'F'.
Patient age must be physiologically valid (between 0 and 125 years).
Encounter total claim cost cannot be negative.
Encounter class must belong to standard set: ['wellness', 'ambulatory', 'outpatient', 'urgentcare', 'emergency', 'inpatient'].
Claim billed amount must be greater than zero.
Encounter stop time must not precede start time.
Encounter date must not exceed current simulation cutoff.
Claim submission date should not occur prior to the date service was rendered.
Claims submitted more than 120 days after service are flagged for timely-filing review.
Payer coverage amount cannot logically exceed total encounter claim cost.
Contractually allowed amount cannot exceed total billed charge.
Insurance paid amount cannot exceed contractually allowed amount.
Death date cannot precede birth date.
Encounter patient_id must exist in dim_patients.
Encounter provider_id must exist in dim_providers.
Encounter organization_id must exist in dim_organizations.
Encounter payer_id must exist in dim_payers.
Procedure encounter_id must exist in fact_encounters.
Medication encounter_id must exist in fact_encounters.
Billing claim encounter_id should map to a valid clinical visit. Orphan bills are flagged for investigation.
